data.name: Canvas
data.subtitle: react flow editor
data.note: React 19 SPA built with Vite. Entry: src/main.tsx -> src/components/app/Editor.tsx. Canvas: src/components/flow/FlowCanvas.tsx (@xyflow/react), with live orthogonal edge routing and port assignment in src/lib/edge-routing.ts, src/lib/ports.ts. Icons render from bundled @ridemountainpig/svgl-react with simple-icons fallback (src/lib/icons.ts); no runtime icon API. PNG/SVG/JSON export runs locally via html-to-image (src/lib/export.ts). The Auto layout button (src/components/flow/AlignBar.tsx) runs the shared ELK layout in the browser.

data.name: Editor state
data.subtitle: zustand store + history
data.note: src/lib/store.ts: Zustand store with 60-snapshot undo/redo, copy/paste and document serialization.

data.name: localStorage
data.subtitle: local autosave
data.note: Keys tech-stack-architect:doc and :recent (src/lib/store.ts), theme and custom colors, plus the owned project's edit token (src/lib/project-sync.ts). The editor works without an account.

data.name: Share sync
data.subtitle: share links, queued sync
data.note: src/lib/share.ts and src/lib/project-sync.ts. Share POSTs /api/projects and keeps the edit token locally; pending changes PUT about once per minute. Opening ?project= GETs the server copy and imports it as an independent local diagram.

data.name: Agent
data.subtitle: any streamable http mcp client
data.note: README documents Codex config; other MCP clients can use the same URL with no auth. Repository analysis happens in the agent; only the diagram is sent.

data.name: Architect skill
data.subtitle: analysis + design guide
data.note: skills/stack-architect/SKILL.md with references/diagram-design.md and references/graph-input.md; agents/openai.yaml. Installed into the agent's skills directory (mcp-instructions.md).

data.name: Projects API
data.subtitle: /api/projects routes
data.note: server/api/projects.post.ts, server/api/projects/[id].get.ts, server/api/projects/[id].put.ts. 1 MB documents; 10 creates and 30 syncs per client per minute. Deployment: README targets Vercel (Nitro preset auto-detected, also serves the Vite SPA); the provider behind the hosted instance is not confirmed by the repository.

data.name: MCP endpoint
data.subtitle: stateless /api/mcp
data.note: server/api/mcp.ts -> server/mcp/handler.ts. Tools: search_architecture_icons (server/mcp/catalog.ts over the shared icon catalog), review_architecture_document (server/mcp/review.ts heuristics), create_architecture_project. Origin and content-type checks; 60 requests/min and 100 creations/day, global.

data.name: Document prep
data.subtitle: validate + elk layout
data.note: server/mcp/document.ts: zod GraphDocument schema, slug/category checks against the catalog, legend node, then layoutDocument from the shared src/lib/layout.ts.

data.name: Persistence
data.subtitle: projects, tokens, quotas
data.note: server/utils/projects.ts: lazy schema creation, 12-character project IDs, SHA-256 edit-token hashes, HMAC client fingerprints and fixed-window rate limits stored in Turso.

data.name: Turso
data.subtitle: shared projects + limits
data.note: Tables shared_projects and share_rate_limits (server/schema.sql), via @tursodatabase/serverless. Credentials are server-only runtime config (nitro.config.ts).

data.name: Icon catalog
data.subtitle: curated + generated
data.note: src/lib/catalog.ts and src/lib/catalog-generated.ts. Used by the editor's asset panel and by MCP icon search and slug validation.

data.name: ELK layout
data.subtitle: elkjs, left to right
data.note: src/lib/layout.ts (layered, orthogonal, nested frames). Used by the editor's Auto layout and by server-side Document prep.

data.name: GraphDocument
data.subtitle: shared types
data.note: src/lib/types.ts. Imported by the editor, the MCP validator and the review heuristics.

data.name: Vite
data.subtitle: dev server + build
data.note: vite.config.ts: React plugin, React Compiler via Babel, Tailwind CSS v4 and the Nitro Vite plugin. npm run build runs tsc -b (TypeScript, verbatimModuleSyntax) before vite build; npm run lint runs oxlint (.oxlintrc.json).

data.name: Tests
data.subtitle: tsx --test
data.note: tests/: MCP protocol, validation and limits with in-memory persistence; layout quality checks for crossings, bends and label collisions.

data.name: Icon generator
data.subtitle: npm run generate:icons
data.note: scripts/generate-svgl-catalog.mjs with scripts/svgl-catalog-overrides.mjs. Scans the svgl-react package and writes src/lib/catalog-generated.ts and src/lib/icon-names-generated.ts.

data.name: svgl API
data.subtitle: icon metadata
data.note: Fetched only when regenerating the catalog; not called at runtime.
